envelope.description: Reconcile canonical writes and persist terminal completion receipts

body.title: Reconcile canonical writes and persist terminal completion receipts
body.summary: Complete publisher retry/recovery: reconcile frozen operation against canonical head/history after lost ACK, create immutable sc5 receipt, and record it through sc4 only after the publication callback queue releases.
acceptanceChecks: Crash after canonical write but before terminal receipt resolves the same operation/revision without rerunning judges or appending a duplicate CR.
Receipt binds run/subject/terminal checkpoint/canonical ID and revision/verdict/coverageRef and is durable before success returns.
Identical terminal replay returns original receipt read-only; mismatching head/content/receipt reports conflict.
Owner/freshness loss or callback timeout cannot become completion; respect sc4 revoked guard and non-reentrant queue contract.
Partial/failed execution never produces a passing CR; accepted findings and usage limitations remain intact.

tests.name: Lost canonical write acknowledgment reconciles one revision and terminal receipt
Terminal replay conflict and revoked callback authority cannot manufacture completion
